subject: general
question: Amongst six friends P, Q, R, S, T and U, each has a different height. R is taller than only one friend. Q is taller than only three friends. T is taller than R but shorter than U. U is not the tallest. U is taller than S. Who is the second tallest among all the friends?
solution:
**Given:** Amongst six friends P, Q, R, S, T and U, each has a different height. 

1) R is taller than only one friend. 

_ > _ > _ > _ > R > _

2) Q is taller than only three friends.

_ > _ > Q > _ > R > _

3) T is taller than R but shorter than U. 

4) U is not the tallest.

_ > U > Q > T > R > _

5) U is taller than S.

After positioning S only one position is left which will be occupied by only person left i.e. P.

P > U > Q > T > R > S

Thus, according to the final arrangement, U is the second tallest among all the friends.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
